rows.sourceContext: Some crops resent having their roots disturbed. They do better sown straight where they'll grow. Beans, carrots and maize belong in that group.
rows.currentComposedTarget: Zwimela zwiṅwe a zwi takaleli musi midzi yazwo i tshi kavanyedzwa. They do better musi zwi tshi zwaliwa nga ho livhaho hune zwa ḓo aluwa hone. Beans, carrots na maize zwi wela kha tshigwada itsho.
rows.fullContextComposition: Zwimela zwiṅwe a zwi takaleli musi midzi yazwo i tshi kavanyedzwa. Zwi aluwa better musi zwi tshi zwaliwa nga ho livhaho hune zwa ḓo aluwa hone. Beans, carrots na maize zwi wela kha tshigwada itsho.

This draft preserves the explicit comparative “better” as an English hold while localizing “They grow”; it does not turn the comparison into merely “grow well.” Risk: better remains English and the fluent reviewer must confirm the comparison construction and its reference to the following sowing clause.
